summary: @arv-bedrock/auth-sso-backend preinstall executes obfuscated bundle under downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {cwd:D})` to run a package-local file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, hex-name identifiers, a multi-thousand-entry mixed literal array driving a rotating string-array decoder function `WV8StW`). The obfuscated payload is not referenced from the declared library entrypoint (`dist/cjs/index.js`) and is not listed in `package.json.files` (which allows only `dist/**/*`); it exists in the tarball solely to be executed by the preinstall dropper. Package metadata is placeholder (`author: ""`, `description: ""`) and the README contains only pipeline-trigger notes, with no relation to the advertised SSO-backend purpose. Executing under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based install-time monitoring, and the opaque payload's behavior cannot be inspected by the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
